cuts.label: xqc@momentmoldycleanwaterwoofer--jwekx3tcmffxe9r/xqc-from-marksman-2026w37
cuts.title: xQc takes a guy's antique gun and shoots him with it
cuts.hook: xQc steals a gun, then uses it
cuts.retelling: In a roleplay, xQc's character takes a man's antique blunderbuss, ignores his pleas and warning that it will blow a huge hole in someone, and shoots him in the ankle to test it, then argues that he couldn't have known.

cuts.label: kaicenat@momentsquarealertlionpraiseit-o0c5aserkk1e3bxk/kaicenat-asks-attack-2026w29
cuts.title: Her favorite song gets her thrown out of Kai's office
cuts.hook: Her favorite song gets her thrown out
cuts.retelling: A student tells Kai that a streamer accused her of being a school shooter over her music taste, Kai doubts it, she plays her favorite song, and he freaks out and throws her out.

cuts.label: scout:harmless+jerma985/harmless-jerma985-bike-charact-2026w41
cuts.title: Harmless Says Jerma Fell for the Oldest Trick
cuts.hook: Harmless says Jerma fell for it
cuts.retelling: Harmless tells a rider to press F and jump off, then brags that Jerma fell for it, and Jerma's own clip shows his bike on fire and him shouting for Donny.

cuts.label: plaqueboymax@vod2875207137/plaqueboymax-beard-gray-2026w38
cuts.title: Gym trainer punishes everybody over one word
cuts.retelling: A gym trainer on Plaqueboymax's stream threatens to punish everyone if anyone talks again, sends the whole gym out to the hill when someone does, then rants and shouts a '10 and 2' punishment that even the streamer doesn't understand.

cuts.label: ishowspeed@vod2875841671/ishowspeed-card-davi-2026w38
cuts.title: Speed begs FC 27 for a good pull, then calls Davies
cuts.retelling: IShowSpeed begs FC 27 for a good pack pull, gets an Ødegaard walkout, then phones Alphonso Davies to tell him he pulled his card, and Davies says he misses him.

cuts.label: alinity@vod2870474986/alinity-alinity-backbend-2026w37
cuts.title: Alinity's workout stream vs her dog Loki
cuts.retelling: Alinity worries about hurting herself during a workout stream, her dog Loki keeps wandering in to interrupt her, and she jokes that he sneaks onto her face.

cuts.label: scout:jynxzi+stableronaldo/jynxzi-stableronaldo-believe-death-2026w41
cuts.title: The Enderman look that ended the run
cuts.retelling: Jynxzi's friends tell him the Minecraft dragon fight is easy, he dies anyway, and a friend accuses him of doing it on purpose by looking at an Enderman.

cuts.label: emiru@vod2892833344/emiru-blood-chest-2026w41
cuts.title: Emiru's cosplay blood won't come off
cuts.hook: Emiru's cosplay blood won't come off
cuts.retelling: Emiru is cosplaying with blood every day of October and can't scrub it off, and the clip ends with her holding up her cat.
